re_admitted_constraints_under_9_13.claim: Realtime task confirmation is a source-grounded HumanIntentDecision precursor only. It must bind immutable invocation/request identity and remains distinct from executor-side EffectDecision and EffectJournal authority.

Realtime conversational memory must enter as MemoryCandidate and pass deterministic MemoryAdmission carrying source/provenance, transformation_class and epistemic_class; persistence or retrieval never promotes remembered content into world truth.

Retrieval/context compilation must preserve epistemic and transformation metadata across conversation-memory and durable-memory matches. Ranking or common treffer shape must not erase the distinction.

CompletionEvidence remains a separate success-only typed receipt boundary bound to invocation/effect identity; textual test:0, stale evidence, non-success or unknown states do not promote completion under 9.13.

hard_invariant: Remembering that somebody said X establishes that memory event/claim provenance, not that X is true. Model Function Calling may propose a MemoryCandidate but cannot mint factual authority.
scope_boundary: The direct Realtime memory path is source-closed for this finding. Do not generalize to every repository consumer until each consumer/context compiler is audited.
triggerword4_acceptance: VERBATIM user utterance and MODEL SUMMARY of the same utterance remain structurally distinct after persistence and retrieval
MODEL INFERENCE cannot satisfy OBSERVED/VERIFIED fact query merely because it was persisted or retrieved
mixed conversation-memory and durable-memory retrieval preserves explicit source/provenance/transformation/epistemic metadata for every item
privacy/retention rejection or redaction produces auditable admission outcome without persisting disallowed raw content
HumanIntentDecision/request identity cannot be reused as EffectDecision for a different downstream mutation
next_exact_gate: Audit all remaining gespraech_erinnerung/durable_memory consumers and context compilers for epistemic-class loss; in parallel, prove the non-provider same-session overlapping-call invocation/effect correlation path before any runtime containment credit.
